jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transform the supplied project model reference into a polished wide 16:9 game UI background concept for FirepowerLoop, a low-poly arcade shooter. References show the actual slim angular human soldier with olive green helmet, bare/light khaki arms, charcoal tactical vest and dark trousers; preserve that design and human proportions, NOT a chibi or bulky sci-fi marine. Ref 1 also shows a charcoal angular giant spider about waist-height with rust red abdomen marking. Ref 2 shows the approved brown low-poly dragon: four legs, long neck and tail, two separate broad wings, warm rust/tan membranes, head height about 2.5 soldiers. Preserve relative physical proportions if these creatures appear, accounting for perspective. Crisp flat-shaded polygon geometry, sophisticated cinematic lighting, restrained detail, clean silhouettes, game-like materials with no photoreal textures. Palette jade/teal sea and cool stone, olive uniforms, warm amber highlights. An illustration concept, not a UI screenshot. NO text, logos, numbers, menus, HUD, bars, button shapes, split panels, borders, watermarks. No volcano, stone giant, camping tent, zombies with gore. Landscape wide 16:9. Asset: MAIN MENU background. Dynamic coastal temple encounter on the LEFT 60%: one foreground soldier at x25% aiming a black rifle leftward toward a low charcoal spider at x8%, short amber muzzle flash. The brown dragon stands in the middle-distance behind a low stone terrace at x48%, visibly four-legged with wings, full readable silhouette, not a mountain-sized giant. Warm late afternoon rim light. Rich turquoise coast, restrained ruined arch silhouettes and a few geometric palms. The RIGHT 40% must smoothly fade to deep desaturated teal atmosphere with extremely low contrast and NO subjects; this is important space for actual menu buttons. Dark soft foreground at bottom. Strong cinematic hierarchy, confident stylized low-poly art, no excessive debris. Use the references to redesign the whole composition.
